profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at GCPay
profile.summary:
With over 15 years of industry experience in software development, I have a wide range of skills and experience to draw upon to help any team I am working with to be as successful as possible.

I have repeatedly been recognized for developing innovative solutions to difficult business problems, delivering solutions faster then expected, providing leadership and guidance to teams and other developers to maximize their potential.   I am typically involved in the full life-cycle development of software, from initial requirement gathering to design, coding, testing, and implementation.  

My technical expertise includes multiple programming languages and frameworks focused primarily in the Java and Javascript space, and advanced knowledge of developer applications, tools, methodologies and best practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Consultant, designing and building custom software solutions to help our clients work smarter, be more efficient and productive.

I have worked on projects for major international companies, ranging from public website infrastructure to tools directly used by internal employees to tools for managing vast software development infrastructure including hundreds of servers, thousands of packages and thousands of database schemas.

From defining requirements to designing the architecture to writing the code, I am often involved in all aspects of the software development life cycle.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
My duties at Sun Microsystems have been extremely varied, including hardware testing, writing custom software, and supporting the manufacturing center.  

Test Engineer – Responsible for writing and maintaining the software to test a variety of hardware platforms, and writing custom software to support manufacturing.

Manufacturing Engineer – Responsible for writing custom software to aid in the manufacturing process. Also responsible for validating complex customer orders from a hardware perspective and working directly with customers to ensure their builds are progressing as desired. Worked closely with manufacturing personnel to build customer orders, design software tools,  provide training, etc.

Senior Test Technician – Responsible for in-depth trouble-shooting of high-end systems,  maintaining the internal network and testing infrastructure, writing training documentation and training new employees.

positions.title: Senior Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Senior Systems Administrator for the Anchorage office of a world-wide law firm. 
Duties included setting up, supporting, maintaining and upgrading hardware and software on a variety of Windows systems (servers, desktops, laptops, and palmtops). I was also responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and upgrading the LAN in the office and the WAN which connected us to our headquarters and from there to all the offices around the world. Many aspects of this job included regular interactions with IT staff in remote locations.
I provided technical support for the office personnel and assisted with complex projects and software training. Additional duties included ordering hardware and supplies, maintaining and programming the phone system, and maintaining fax machines. I supported standard Windows programs such as MS Office, along with specialized software including Exchange, Views, CMS, Lexis, Interaction, and other law-related software products.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Windows NT network administration for client companies. 
This included setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting NT networks with exchange servers, internet connections, network-wide virus protection systems, file and printer sharing groups, and network printers. I designed a PC inventory management system for a large office, provided user technical support, and set up and troubleshot client PCs.
